series.title: Amazon signs first Asia Pacific standalone battery storage tolling deal for 50MW BESS in Australia
series.summary: Anza Power has signed a tolling agreement with Amazon Australia for the 50MW/200MWh Bairnsdale BESS in East Gippsland, Victoria.

series.title: Climate groups slam Germany’s ‘pro-gas’ capacity market design as European Commission grants state aid approval
series.summary: The European Commission’s late approval of Germany’s capacity market auctions leaves no room for public scrutiny, according to environmental law charity ClientEarth.

series.title: Google partners with MN8 Energy and Eos on West Virginia solar-plus-LDES project
series.summary: Developer-operator MN8 Energy, zinc hybrid cathode battery and storage system maker Eos Energy Enterprises, and tech giant Google are backing a multi-technology renewables project on the PJM grid in the US.

series.title: Engie starts up 251MW BESS projects in Chile, Grenergy sells fourth phase of Atacama solar-plus-storage complex
series.summary: Power firm Engie and IPP Grenergy are advancing three solar-plus-BESS projects in Chile.

series.title: Inertia in Germany is ‘first bankable long-term revenue stream,’ could boost battery storage IRR by 1-2pp
series.summary: Inertia could provide a strong boost to BESS project returns in Germany, but operators are still waiting for the first prequalified inverters.

series.title: Land-based wind power pipeline shrinks as price gap with solar widens
series.summary: John Hensley, senior vice president of markets and policy analysis at ACP, told Utility Dive that his organization has calculated at least 44 GW of wind projects are “stuck” in review at the U.S. Department of Defense.

series.title: China’s half-year energy storage deployments post first-ever decline to 22GW/59GWh, while overseas orders surge 83%
series.summary: CNESA's report is a comprehensive overview of China’s energy storage sector in H1 2026 and outlines the industry outlook under the 15th Five-Year Plan.

series.title: Energy Vault secures full land ownership for 1GWh Stoney Creek BESS in Australia
series.summary: Energy Vault has completed the acquisition of the underlying project land for its 125MW/1,000MWh Stoney Creek battery energy storage system (BESS) in northern New South Wales, Australia.

series.title: Under the hood: Inside Tesla’s Megapack 3 as Texas production begins
series.summary: Tesla was one of the pioneers of the grid-scale battery storage market, but has faced increasing competition in the past few years. In this article we look under the hood of its latest grid-scale BESS product, the Megapack 3.

series.title: BESS Industry Buzz: German grid attack, revenue cannibilisation, CATL’s price cut, sodium-ion’s ramp-up and more
series.summary: A roundup of user-posted analysis, views and unofficial news from across the industry this past week, this time looking at this week's sabotage attack on the German grid, BESS revenues and electricity market activity, CATL's LFP price cut and various non-lithium news.

series.title: Equinor’s East Point Energy begins operations at 200MWh Texas BESS
series.summary: East Point Energy, owned by Norwegian state-owned energy company Equinor has completed construction and started operations at the 100MW/200MWh Citrus Flatts energy storage project in Harlingen, Texas, US.

series.title: OptiGrid to optimise Vena Energy’s 408MW Bellambi Heights BESS in Australia
series.summary: OptiGrid has been selected by Vena Energy to provide trading optimisation services for the 408MW Bellambi Heights BESS in Australia.

series.title: EDF Power Solutions Australia seeks EPBC Act approval for 4GWh pumped hydro plant
series.summary: EDF Power Solutions Australia has referred the Wala Wala Pumped Hydro Energy Storage project, a 300-400MW facility in NSW.

series.title: Macquarie-backed Blueleaf Energy and Universal Peak close financing on Malaysia tender-winning BESS project
series.summary: Blueleaf Energy and Universal Peak have closed financing for a 100MW/400MWh battery storage project, which was one of four winning bids in a Malaysian government tender.

series.title: Pakistan’s regulator approves mandatory energy storage component for renewables auction
series.summary: Pakistan's National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (NEPRA) has approved plans to require bidders in a renewable energy auction to include energy storage.

series.title: Octopus Australia refers 2GWh Blackstone BESS for EPBC Act assessment in Queensland
series.summary: Octopus Australia has referred the Blackstone battery energy storage system (BESS), a 500MW/2,000MWh standalone facility, to Australia's federal government for assessment under the Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation (EPBC) Act.

series.title: Energy Fiji partners with EPC Renewables on 240MWh solar-plus-storage site
series.summary: EPC Renewables has signed an MoU with state-linked utility Energy Fiji Limited for the development of the Yaqara Solar & Battery Project.

series.title: Pan-European battery storage and renewable energy platform Aukera closes €460 million credit facility
series.summary: Aukera has closed a €460 million (US$534.23 million) structured credit facility to advance its project pipeline in five European markets.

series.title: Belgium: EDF inaugurates 600MWh BESS, Engie starts building 296MWh project
series.summary: EDF Power Solutions has put a 150MW/600MWh BESS in Belgium into commercial operation while Engie has started building a 74MW/296MWh project.

series.title: Yemen’s largest solar plant set to double to 240 MW
series.summary: Yemen is expanding its largest solar power plant in Aden from 120 MW to 240 MW with UAE funding, while plans for a separate 50 MW project in Hadhramaut are also advancing. The projects form part of a growing pipeline of utility-scale solar developments across the country. The post Yemen’s largest solar plant set to…

series.title: ‘It looks like there could be an undersupply of the highest efficiency’
series.summary: Alastair Mounsey, VP for Europe discusses JA's solar moduel module strategy, why quality matters, and the growing role of energy storage in the business. The post ‘It looks like there could be an undersupply of the highest efficiency’ appeared first on pv magazine Global .

series.title: PJM targets data centre demand with 6GW backstop auction; BESS expected to have competitive edge
series.summary: PJM has proposed a major overhaul of how it procures power capacity in response to surging data centre demand that has driven auction prices up more than 1,000% in two years and threatens to add US$70 per month to average household electricity bills by 2028.

series.title: North Macedonia’s BESS market begins to develop
series.summary: Analysis from Solar Macedonia says both standalone and co-located battery projects are beginning to materialise, while recent drought conditions have been favorable to the economic viability of solar projects. The post North Macedonia’s BESS market begins to develop appeared first on pv magazine Global .

series.title: HiNa Battery scales Korean sodium-ion partnership from 15 MWh to 10 GWh
series.summary: HiNa Battery signed a five-year deal to supply South Korea’s Volta with 10 GWh of sodium-ion batteries, expanding an earlier 15 MWh storage partnership. series.title: South Korea to expand renewable monitoring mandate to 20 kW
series.summary: The South Korean government says it will require far smaller solar, wind and fuel-cell installations to carry real-time monitoring and remote-control capability from 2027, easing the switch to commercial mobile networks along the way. series.title: Togo kicks off solar tender
series.summary: Togo is tendering a solar project to be built in the northern part of its capital, Lomé. The planned capacity of the plant has not been disclosed. The deadline for prequalification is September 15. The post Togo kicks off solar tender appeared first on pv magazine Global .

series.title: Solarworld, Rays Power plan 2.4 GW solar cell factory in India
series.summary: Solarworld Energy Solutions and Rays Power Infra have formed a 50:50 joint venture to build a 2.4 GW n-type TOPCon solar cell factory in Madhya Pradesh, India. series.summary: Soren is seeking companies to develop thin-film PV module recycling solutions in France for CdTe and CIGS technologies, with proposals due Oct. 21, 2026. series.title: EU deploys 33.8 GW of solar in H1
series.summary: SolarPower Europe expects the EU to install 68.1 GW of solar capacity in 2026, just 2.1% below the record 69.6 GW added in 2025.
